experiment: RADAR-VLM final Stage-1 plus Stage-2 evaluation

definitions.stage2_false_negative: Attack still meets target similarity threshold after purification.
definitions.stage2_false_positive: Clean sample suffers severe CIDEr drop, defined as after/before ratio < 0.30.
definitions.cascade_note: High-risk attacks are blocked; Medium-risk attacks are purified; Low-risk attacks pass. Clean High blocks and severe Medium clean degradation are counted as false positives.
